consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 120 km/h steady, 19 °C, dry, 18-inch wheels (235/45-18 Michelin e-Primacy), battery-side (car display; sheet does not say explicitly) | Nyland, 'Tesla Model 3 LR Highland' (dual-motor Long Range AWD, Highland generation, 74.5 kWh measured usable; same 82 kWh gross NMC pack and layout as our Premium AWD-I). Our trim's standard wheel is 18-inch, same as the test. Test car model year not stated (Highland = 2024+). Same car at 90 km/h, 17 °C: 123 Wh/km. Winter row (3 °C, wet, Falken winter tyres): 226 Wh/km at 120 km/h. Not used: evmagazine.eu/zerofy repeat the same 161 figure..

heat_pump.notes: EV Database Long Range AWD (Highland) lists heat pump standard; mapped to Premium AWD by content (same Highland AWD car, renamed). Fact-check: the cited EV Database page may be the pre-Highland LR AWD; low confidence.

wheels.notes: Canadian Premium AWD: 570 km range quoted for the standard 18-inch wheels.
Upgrading to 19-inch wheels reduces range to 520 km (option; price not on page).
